content_sections.heading: RGNIYD Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RGNIYD Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RGNIYD Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Professor (Applied Psychology): Master’s degree with 55% marks in relevant subject + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018 Assistant Professor (English): Master’s degree with 55% marks in relevant subject + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018 Assistant Professor (Public Administration): Master’s degree with 55% marks in relevant subject + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018 Assistant Professor (Social Work): Master’s degree with 55% marks in relevant subject + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018

content_sections.text: Assistant Professor (All Subjects): Rs. 52,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGNIYD Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Rajiv Gandhi National Institute of Youth Development (RGNIYD) for faculty positions based in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for the position of Assistant Professor across multiple academic disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for RGNIYD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates can directly report to the designated venue with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview, along with registration and certificate verification, is scheduled to take place on 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 52,000/- per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree with a minimum of 55% marks in a relevant or allied subject, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. degree as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, and ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What subjects have open vacancies for Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in Applied Psychology, English, Public Administration, and Social Work departments.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, mark sheets, identity proofs, category certificates, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the institute?
faq.answer: You can visit the official RGNIYD website at https://www.rgniyd.gov.in/ for further updates and detailed official notifications.
